title: Whistling UFO seen near Aztec

tellings.quote: The UFO came from that [music] direction over there, but it was making this sound like almost whistling.

plain: A UFO flew over the country near Aztec, New Mexico, making a sound almost like whistling. An unnamed local witness tells this on camera, pointing to the direction it came from, in an episode about a claimed crash near Aztec said to have left sixteen alien bodies.
